_about: Read by tools/images.mjs. One entry per published image: its source in assets-src/, the slot ratio it is cropped to (null keeps the source ratio), the focal point as fractions of the source (x, y), and the derivative widths. Widths are fitted to each slot at 2x and never exceed the source. Credits live in public/images/credits.md.

images.name: kiama-harbour-first-light
images._why: Revision 2026-11-11, item 16 and the Chief Officer's condition: a coast at first light from high up, with a place in it (Kiama harbour, NSW), no industry, land in every pane. Widths: a 358px row at 390 (x2 is 716) up to about 1300px at 1440 with the drift margin, 3200 for 2x screens.

images.name: departure-hall-walker
images._why: The walker sits at 40 to 65% of the source height; this crop keeps them in the top two thirds of the card, clear of the text band. Revision 2026-11-11, item 17: the entry cards are 3:2 at 1440 (604 x 403), so the crop is 3:2 too.

images.name: hotel-room-sheer-window
images._why: Critic round 2 found the first hotel photo soft and windowless in its crop. This crop sits low, so the pillows and duvet stay above the text band and the tall windows fill the top. Revision 2026-11-11, item 17: the entry cards are 3:2 at 1440 (604 x 403), so the crop is 3:2 too.

images.name: trust-reception-sign
images._why: Revision 2026-11-11, item 19: a calm check-in subject, faces out of frame, no national emblems. Critic round, 11 Nov: the first pick (a brass bell) was dark and showed the photographer reflected in it; this reception sign on a whitewashed wall over the sea is light and on-brand.
